intro: GTA 6 came out on Thursday 19 November 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It unlocked at midnight local time, country by country, starting in New Zealand, so the launch rolled around the world over about 19 hours.

notes: Online: Rockstar describes GTA 6 as a single-player experience. No online mode has been announced, and dates you see elsewhere are rumours.
PC: not at launch. GamesBeat reported, citing four sources, that it's planned for January to March 2027. Rockstar hasn't confirmed it.
Playing early: some players switch to a New Zealand account or region. On PlayStation that needs a separate NZ account and a copy bought from that store.
PS5: Sony released a system software update that you need to install before GTA 6 will start. Rockstar shared PlayStation's notice on launch night.
